description: This file contains functions for loading and processing behavioral event data into SQLite databases, including functions for loading individual events and aggregated events, with detailed SQL table creation and indexing.

methods.name: load_events_in_db
methods.description: Populates an in-memory SQLite database with events from specified observations, subjects, and behaviors, creating appropriate tables and indexes.

methods.name: load_aggregated_events_in_db
methods.description: Creates an in-memory SQLite database with aggregated events from selected observations, subjects, and behaviors, combining individual events into state or point events.
